1.why: The UI uses a clean sans-serif typeface with clear letter spacing and comfortable line spacing throughout the form.

2.why: All visible text is regular sentence-case with no italics, all-caps, or dense paragraphs.

3.why: The layout is a narrow single-column stacked form with large controls that fits and remains readable at mobile width.

4.why: Instructions such as “Confirm your account details before setting up payment security” and the demo note are short and in plain language.

5.why: Placeholders explicitly show example values (marcus@example.com and +15551234567) and a note tells the user to use them.

6.why: No screen requires reading any long block of text; all copy is brief labels and one-sentence instructions.

7.why: No long codes or secrets appear in any of the four screenshots, so copy-instead-of-type support cannot be observed.

8.why: No QR code or equivalent alternative to manual entry is offered on any screen.

9.why: Standard email and telephone input fields are used and shown pre-filled, which is compatible with browser autofill and password managers.

10.why: The header shows “MFA enrolment”, the heading states the current task, and the primary blue Continue button stands out clearly (and is further highlighted).

11.why: Only one main action—the Continue button—is presented at a time.

12.why: After Continue the system only shows a generic “We could not complete that request. Please try again.” banner without plainly stating what happened or what comes next.

13.why: The user can immediately retry by pressing Continue again with no lock-out or penalty visible; no code reveal/hide/re-request UI appears because codes are never reached.

14.why: The error avoids blaming the user and says to try again, yet it never states the actual problem or a concrete fix.

15.why: No countdown, expiry, or other time limit is shown on any screen.
